summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PropTech platform 10-point UI/UX overhaul. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend tests passed for all major features: Hero CTA, lead capture modal, navigation restructure, 4-package cards, 5-step process, card-based Why Choose Us, calculator with real-time estimate, partner registration with mocked OTP, vendor registration with optional fields, collaboration page with value models, and admin link in footer.
passed_tests: Homepage hero loads with 'Start Your Project' button that opens lead capture modal
Lead capture modal submits to POST /api/quick-lead and shows success
Navigation bar shows: Home, Our Services, Collaboration, Sales, Partner (NO 'Packages' link)
Homepage packages section with 4 cards: Classic/Select/Signature/Customize with correct prices (1899/2199/2599/Custom)
Homepage process section shows exactly 5 steps: Requirement Collection, Estimation & Agreement, Planning & Design, Construction, Handover & Warranty
Homepage Why Choose Us section shows card-based layout (not comparison table)
Calculator page shows 4 package options: Classic/Select/Signature/Customize
Calculator real-time estimate updates as user types area and selects package (2000 x 1899 = 37,98,000)
POST /api/calculate rejects invalid project types with 400 error
POST /api/calculate rejects invalid package types (basic/premium/luxury) with 400 error
POST /api/calculate returns correct cost = area * rate_per_sft
Partner page shows landing page with 'Become a Partner' and 'Partner Login' buttons
Partner registration form: Name, Phone, Email -> sends OTP (mocked, always 123456)
Partner OTP verification at POST /api/partner/verify-otp creates partner with is_active=false
Vendor registration works without company_name and email (both optional)
Collaboration page shows 'Generate Income From Your Land' value models section
Admin login link visible in footer
POST /api/vendors accepts request without email and company_name
seed_data_creation: Package configs seeded: Classic 1899/sft, Select 2199/sft, Signature 2599/sft, Customize 0 (custom quote)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10-point UI/UX overhaul features tested and working. Backend validation for project types and package types is working correctly (rejects invalid values). Partner OTP is mocked (always 123456). Calculator uses client-side calculation with useMemo (liveEstimate) - no API call needed for display. Fixed vendor form label to show 'Company Name (Optional)' instead of required.
